description: Only after the proof gate, transform the verified canonical specification into a detailed language-agnostic implementation DAG. Generate declaration-to-task traceability, dependency edges, obligations, artifact/checker bindings and small tasks; require designated-model review and full coverage before execution.

Finish Bootstrapping_MetaRocq-rs_MetaTheory by independently replaying the actual equivalence certificate using the exact original compiled checker, its independent kernel root and the qualified HOL4 bridge. Bind all source, specification, theorem, assumption, compiler and binary identities; reject unresolved obligations and circular trust.

Compile the original checker and retained proof data through untyped LambdaBox, Peregrine and CakeML. Prove concrete preservation through serialization, compiler, runtime, linking and the selected ISA, including input/output and failure behavior; retain an independent bootstrap checker and explicit trust ledger.

Rebuild original MetaRocq from pinned source with complete dependency provenance. Instantiate its actual checker and replay its soundness, universes, normalization and guard obligations against an independently retained original kernel.

Extend additive Type-level quotation to dependency-closed original programs with opaque bodies, universe constraints and primitive declarations. Prove faithful quotation, sharing and untyped LambdaBox erasure preserve reconstructible proof syntax and its original interpretation.

Define operational behavior for allocation, primitives, overflow, panics, divergence, resource exhaustion and external interfaces. Relate Rust-native operations to original Template-Rocq, PCUIC, checking, erasure and quotation; cover OCaml plugins, Ltac, commands, functors and all inventory items through explicit semantics rather than silent omission.

Execute the generated implementation tasks with read-all/write-own contexts. Prove actual generated Rust and every printer repair, ownership-aware lowering and macro expansion refine the verified contract; bind dependency/generator identities and add bounded Kani regressions without treating them as full semantic proof.

Specify the Rust constructs needed by the full port: syntax, binding, traits/generics, types, lifetimes, moves, shared/mutable loans, aliasing, drops and permitted unsafe/FFI boundaries. Reuse qualified Charon/Aeneas semantics where applicable; prove the frontend relation and ownership/type preservation, with every unsupported construct explicit.

Compile MetaRocq-rs with rustc, use it to produce its retained-proof untyped LambdaBox program, then Peregrine/CakeML machine code. Prove each transformation, checker input interpretation and machine boundary; have original and MetaRocq-rs compiled checkers independently validate source and executable against identical canonical specification bytes, retaining the independent original trust root.

Generate proof transport along the shared semantic relation and prove metatheory equivalence for the full declared contract. Preserve theorem statements, complete environments, universes and assumption sets; prove both directions where equivalence is claimed and state termination/resource premises explicitly.

Define shared canonical specification bytes, grammar, well-formedness, universes, declarations and semantics using original MetaRocq mathematics. Prove decoding and round trips plus a semantics-preserving Rocq/PCUIC-to-HOL4 interpretation; both eventual checkers must consume the same syntax and semantics.
Audit pinned original sources, source coverage, retained opaque proof data, CakeML wrapper assumptions and available proof tooling. Emit observations and blockers, never a metatheory claim.
